title: Chill&Stay
description: This is a modpack for my private smp, includes new building blocks, new foods, mobs some new bosses and enemys, a lot of QoL features, and the necessery optimanizations
body:
# A modpack for chill gameplay with a bit of excitement.

It contains all the neccessery optimanization mods so low end pc-s can play too!
It is recommended to pre-gennerate the world for the best experience.

# WARNING!:
Before updating from version to another please do a world save!
Things can break between versions even if there is no change that would do that, things breaks somethimes in unexpected ways :( 
This is will be true from updateing from version 0.3.0 to 0.4.0 because of mod changes be aware.

## Important
This is by no means perfect or balanced all around so keep this in mind.
This pack only contains the mods that are needed for the client to join the server, meaning this modpack does not contain serverside only mods and datapacks.
I will list down below the server side resources seperatly if you want the full experience.

## This modpack contains:


<details>
<summary>features:</summary>

- a lot of new building blcok, furniture and also compliteing the basic game block palette
- new foods and drinks and there making mechanics
- more villager jobs with usefull crafting blocks
- carts, backpacks and storage drowers so you can storage a ton of items in one place and move them more easily
- modified day/night cycle now days are 40 minutes instead of 10 and nights are 20 minutes instead of 10
- added seasons, mostly just visual changes, does not affect crop grow because of incompatibilities
- more than 30 new friendly/neutral creatures, some aggresive
- genereal optimanization
- quicker resourcepack/datapack loading
- new sounds (rain, inventory, block placing, block breaking, footsteps etc) you can disable almost all of them seperatly
- new music discs
- new particles, you can disable all of them
- QoL feaures:
  - you can move while your inventory is open
  - you can connect sign to write on them long texts
  - horse buffes (they can move over leafs, can swim with space, can be called to you with a horn, you can switch between you and the horse inventory etc)
  - easier resourcepack management
  - mouse tweak easier item relocating, splitting etc
  - inventory and container quick actions (sorting, moving all/specific items)
  - you can see now the saturation in more detail
  - you can see now wwhat items did you pick up
  - one more F1 mode
  - better more customizeable third persion view
  - improved spyglass with more feaurez (zoom filter, quick access, etc)
  - effect status bars on the main screen
  - quicker block placement and easier block placement
  - search for the keybind controls
  - small tweaks

</details>



## what is coming:

- new enemys
- new armors/clothes/weapons
- probably more QoL features
- probably more survival elements
- new structures ( this will be mostly only on the server side so i will post that seperatly if needed)
- a system that replace or rework echanting to be not a gambling overpower thing with grinding XP for hours


## Issues or suggestions:
Join my [discord server](https://discord.gg/rcUteAyJwe)

## FAQ

<details>
<summary>Can i disable/change XY sound effect, particle effects?</summary>
Sure you can most of this are changeable in the mods tab or in the sounds sections.
  
mods:
- subtle effects
- cool rain
- sounds
- presence footsteps
</details>
